rules.statement: The phrase 'under the same restrictions as before' in paragraph 12 refers to the restriction against inheritance by the children of a second marriage of any one of the immediate devisees, in addition to the fidei commissum mentioned in paragraph 10.
rules.supporting_quote: "Now, on a comparison of the two paragraphs 10 and 12 it will be seen that there is a great similarity between them. In paragraph 10 the property in the Fourth Cross street is devised to John Anderson Dias and Livertina subject to a fidei commissum; and immediately after the words' 'fidei commissum,'' comes the proviso against the issue of a second marriage that I have already cited. In paragraph 12 the property in Canal row is devised to John Anderson Dias and others, and immediately after the words 'fidei commissum' follow the words' and under the same restrictions as before.'"
